name: boot
eval: bend.set('camera', { followDist: 3.3, followFov: 42, followPitch: 0.1 }); bend.place(0, 0, 0, Math.PI / 2);

name: ginga.front.0
eval: bend.intent(0, null); bend.place(0, 0, 0, Math.PI / 2); bend.camera({ yaw: 1.5708, pitch: 0.1, idle: 0 });

name: ginga.side.0
eval: bend.intent(0, null); bend.place(0, 0, 0, Math.PI / 2); bend.camera({ yaw: 0.0000, pitch: 0.1, idle: 0 });

name: run.side
eval: bend.intent(0, null); bend.place(0, -4, 0, Math.PI / 2); bend.camera({ yaw: 0.0000, pitch: 0.1, idle: 0 }); bend.intent(0, { moveX: 0, moveZ: 0 }); bend.camera({ yaw: 0.0, pitch: 0.1 }); bend.intent(0, { moveX: 1 });

name: walk.side
eval: bend.intent(0, null); bend.place(0, -3, 0, Math.PI / 2); bend.camera({ yaw: 0.0000, pitch: 0.1, idle: 0 }); bend.intent(0, { moveX: 1, walk: true });

name: walk.turn
eval: bend.intent(0, { moveX: 0, moveZ: 1, walk: true }); bend.camera({ yaw: 0.6 });

name: jump.ready
eval: bend.intent(0, null); bend.place(0, 0, 0, Math.PI / 2); bend.camera({ yaw: 0.3000, pitch: 0.1, idle: 0 });

name: crouch
eval: bend.intent(0, null); bend.place(0, 0, 0, Math.PI / 2); bend.camera({ yaw: 0.3000, pitch: 0.1, idle: 0 }); bend.intent(0, { moveY: -1 });
